sentences.text: Mr. Resham Lal Jaiswal, Advocate for the Appellant.
Mr. Anish Tiwari, Dy.G.A. for the State/respondent.
Also heard on I.A. No. 01/2025, application under Section 430 of BNSS for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

By the impugned judgment dated 03.07.2025 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, 02nd Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), District-Raipur (C.G.) in Special Criminal Case No. 22/2021, the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
Conviction Sentence U/s 376(2)(f)(n) of R.I. for 10 years and fine of IPC.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 02nd Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), District-Raipur (C.G.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Rs. 50/-, in default of payment of fine amount additional R.I. for 07 days.
U/s 506 Part-II R.I. for 01 year. of IPC U/s 323 of IPC R.I. for 06 months.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The prosecution failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

He further submits Xyz vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69046306/
1 that the there are contradictions in the statements of the prosecution witnesses and the allegations levelled against the appellant.

The appellant is in jail since 15.10.2020 and has already served the jail sentence of about 05 years 04 months 10 days, the disposal of this appeal is likely to take considerable time, therefore, considering all these facts the jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended till the final disposal of the appeal and the appellant be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the bail application and submitting that the victim has fully supported the case of the prosecution.
I have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the nature and gravity of the offence and the material available on record against the appellant, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the appellant.

List this case for final hearing in the week commencing 23.03.2026 Sd/-
(Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal) Judge Sourabh P.
